senses.en_definition: Only; merely; used to emphasize a restriction or limitation.

messages.en: Let's go out for a bite. You've been working all morning. Aren't you bored?
I'm absolutely exhausted. All I want right now is a little rest. I'll grab something to eat myself later, okay?
I've checked the ingredients. It contains something Muslims aren't allowed to eat, so I don't want that one.
Okay, let's just pick something that's halal-certified.

senses.en_definition: To hope for something or wish for something to happen.

collocations.en: hope to be able to attend

senses.en_definition: Please; used to introduce a request or instruction.
To rely on or trust someone or something.

collocations.en: don't count on it; don't even think about it

senses.en_definition: (Literary or in fixed expressions) A hope or wish for something to be obtained or to happen.

messages.en: I really hope it doesn't rain tomorrow. I've been wanting to go to the beach for ages.
Me too! If the weather's nice, let's head out a little earlier, okay?

senses.en_definition: A feeling of hope or expectation that something desired will happen.
Something hoped for; the possibility of a desired outcome.
A person trusted or counted on to succeed or achieve something.

collocations.en: young people who are the hope of the nation

messages.en: I reckon there's no hope now. It's been a week, and I still haven't heard a thing from HR.
There's still hope. They said we'd hear back next week, didn't they?
Oh yeah, you've got a point. I'll give it a bit more time.
